warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical LEFT half (the higher-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 8/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 7/21 (2.3 งานตกแต่งพื้น, RIGHT half) extracted as _1.json.
Item mark ผ1/ผ2 (ผ = ผนัง/wall) printed in the ลำดับที่ column exactly as shown.

LOW-CONFIDENCE DECISION: row 2's wall-thickness word after 'หนา' does not clearly resolve to a real Thai word at 3x zoom -- the glyph most resembles 'เม' + 'แผ่น' (which is not a standard term) rather than a clean 'เต็ม'. Domain convention for ก่ออิฐมอญ (Mon-brick masonry) BOQ lines pairs 'ครึ่งแผ่น' (half-brick) with 'เต็มแผ่น' (full-brick) as the two standard thickness callouts, and the row directly above this one is unambiguously 'ครึ่งแผ่น' -- decided to transcribe this row as 'เต็มแผ่น' on that domain-convention basis rather than transcribe an illegible non-word, and flagged with confidence_score 0.55 (lowered specifically for this word, not the row's clearly-legible quantity/unit) rather than left blank. A human should re-check this word against the original PDF/higher-resolution source before this row is used with high confidence.

Both 'เสาเอ็นและคานทับหลัง' rows (169m and 6m) print the identical parenthetical '( ขนาดก่ออิฐครึ่งแผ่น )' -- re-verified at 3x zoom, this is not a misread; the source genuinely repeats 'ครึ่งแผ่น' on both rows even though the second one sits directly under the 'เต็มแผ่น' wall-thickness row above and might be expected to reference 'เต็มแผ่น' by parallel construction. Transcribed exactly as printed on the standing 'record as given, don't guess' rule, not silently corrected to match the adjacent wall row.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet, including the 'รวมข้อ 2.4' subtotal row -- transcribed as null, not invented.
All quantities re-verified at 3x zoom after rotating a programmatic crop of the left half (258, 17, 169, 6, 466, 72, 37, 62).
